datasetProvenance.source: Region identifiers and metadata (code, name, launch year, AZ count, geography type) compiled from the official AWS Global Infrastructure documentation and the AWS Systems Manager public parameter namespace /aws/service/global-infrastructure/... . Coordinates are approximate centroids of each Region's publicly named metro/city location, taken from well-known public geographic facts (standard latitude/longitude of the named city or metro area).
datasetProvenance.accuracyNote: Coordinates are approximate centroids of each Region's publicly named metro/city location, NOT AWS datacenter locations. AWS does not publish datacenter coordinates. Values are rounded to ~2 decimal places and are intended only as geographic reference points for visualization and great-circle distance estimation.
datasetProvenance.license: Derived compilation. Region metadata is factual AWS-published infrastructure data (AWS Global Infrastructure docs + SSM public parameters). Coordinates are factual public geographic facts (city/metro centroids); individual lat/lon facts are not copyrightable and no third-party dataset was copied. The compilation is published in-repo for use within this project. See data/README.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §6.
